exposure: use of automated insulin delivery (AID) systems
cohort: Pregnant women with Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) using automated insulin delivery (AID) systems.
finding: TIRp > 59.1% and mean glucose < 133 mg/dL in the second trimester are associated with a lower incidence of large for gestational age (LGA) in fetuses of pregnant women with Type 1 Diabetes using AID systems.
